blocks.en: Synthetic biology is a field of science that involves redesigning organisms to have new, useful abilities for the world. Scientists use organisms such as e. coli in engineering to give them various purposes previously unexplored. In synbio, different parts of DNA are stitched together to create a zombie that will eat us all and blow up the world!!! kidding. In reality, all those recombined DNA pieces are then put into organisms we call chassis to perform the intended purpose, such as vaccination, crop enhancement, and many more.

blocks.zh: 合成生物學是一門科學領域，旨在重新設計生物體，使其具備對世界有益的新能力。科學家透過工程手段利用大腸桿菌等生物體，賦予它們過去未曾探索過的各種用途。在合成生物學中，我們會將不同的 DNA 片段拼接在一起，創造出一個會吃掉我們所有人並炸毀世界的殭屍！！！開玩笑的。實際上，所有這些重組後的 DNA 片段會被植入我們稱為底盤（chassis）的生物體中，以實現預期的功能，例如疫苗開發、作物改良等。

blocks.en: It’s inevitable in science that there will be times when morals and what is right needs to be considered, especially in a field in synbio where it’s kind of like making a Frankenstein organism, which raises concerns about how safe and moral it is. In very basic terms, don’t be a war criminal. All science has the potential to be bad, but it’s up to us to make it beneficial instead of detrimental for humanity.

blocks.zh: 做科學的過程中，難免有必須思考道德與對錯的時候；在合成生物學這種有點像在製造科學怪人生物的領域更是如此，也因此引來它到底安不安全、合不合乎道德的疑慮。講最基本的：不要當戰犯。所有科學都有可能走向壞的一面，但要讓它造福人類而不是危害人類，取決於我們自己。
